answer_1.quote: In this work we explore new data and modern conditional text generation models to simplify medical documents... We propose and evaluate an encoder-decoder model for paragraph-level simplification.

answer_2.quote: We report SARI , a standard edit‑based metric for text simplification, and BLEU , ... Finally we report the F1 versions of ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, and ROUGE-L ... We also report Flesch‑Kincaid, ARI, and SciBERT masked probability scores for generated PLS.

answer_4.quote: We manually examined the outputs generated by our models on a random sample of 40 technical abstracts from the test split of our dataset... In this section we comment on the generated texts' readability, quality of summarization and simplification, stylistic fidelity with the PLS, and overall coherence and simplicity based on human examination.
answer_4.guideline: Human raters inspected each generated summary for readability, coherence, information completeness, hallucinations, misspellings, and repetition.
